en: The South African Republic, also known as the Transvaal Republic, as a landlocked independent Boer republic in Southern Africa from 1852 to 1902
Its annexation into the British Empire after the Anglo-Boer War
zh: 德兰士瓦共和国又称南非共和国，是1852至1902年南部非洲内陆的独立布尔人共和国
英布战争后被并入大英帝国

politics.zh: 德兰士瓦共和国又称南非共和国，是南部非洲内陆的独立布尔人共和国，存在于1852至1902年，以比勒陀利亚为都，由选举产生的总统与议会治理。它因金矿的发现成为英国扩张的目标，1899至1902年英布战争后战败，1902年被英国吞并，1910年其地成为南非联邦的省份之一。
politics.en: The South African Republic, also known as the Transvaal Republic, was a landlocked independent Boer republic in Southern Africa that existed from 1852 to 1902, with Pretoria as its capital and an elected president and assembly as its government. The discovery of gold made it the target of British expansion, and after defeat in the Anglo-Boer War of 1899-1902 it was annexed into the British Empire in 1902, its territory becoming a province of the Union of South Africa in 1910.

economy.zh: 经济以布尔人的农牧业为基础，1886年威特沃特斯兰德金矿的发现使国家财政与移民结构剧变，铁路与矿业城市发展迅速，英国资本与劳工大量涌入。
economy.en: The economy rested on Boer farming and herding until the discovery of gold on the Witwatersrand in 1886 transformed public finances and immigration, with railways and mining towns growing rapidly and British capital and labour arriving in large numbers.

culture.zh: 共和国以布尔人的加尔文宗传统与南非荷兰语文化为基础，共和理念与地方自治是其政治认同核心，与英国的冲突强化了布尔人的民族记忆，成为后来南非政治的重要线索。
culture.en: The republic rested on Boer Calvinist tradition and Afrikaans culture, with republican ideas and local self-government at the core of its political identity; the conflict with Britain strengthened Afrikaner national memory and became an important thread in later South African politics.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1852年确立独立、1860年比勒陀利亚成为首都、1886年金矿发现、1899至1902年英布战争，以及1902年被英国吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the confirmation of independence in 1852, Pretoria becoming the capital in 1860, the discovery of gold on the Witwatersrand in 1886, the Anglo-Boer War of 1899 to 1902 and the British annexation of 1902. Its goldfields later became the industrial heart of the wider region.

value.zh: 1886年威特沃特斯兰德金矿的发现改变国家命运。
value.en: The discovery of gold on the Witwatersrand in 1886 changed its fortunes.

en: Atropatene, also known as Atropatia or Atropatian Media, as an ancient Iranian kingdom established around 323 BC
Its foundation by the Persian satrap Atropates after the death of Alexander
Its name as the origin of the modern name Azerbaijan
zh: 阿特罗帕特尼又称阿特罗帕特米底，是约公元前323年建立的古代伊朗王国
由波斯总督阿特罗帕特斯在亚历山大死后建立
其名称演变成为今日阿塞拜疆一名的来源

politics.zh: 阿特罗帕特尼又称阿特罗帕特米底，是约公元前323年建立的古代伊朗王国，由波斯总督阿特罗帕特斯在亚历山大死后建立。它先后从属于塞琉古、亚美尼亚与罗马的势力范围，保持本地王统与琐罗亚斯德教传统，其名称经中古波斯语演变，成为今日阿塞拜疆一名的来源。
politics.en: Atropatene, also known as Atropatia or Atropatian Media, was an ancient Iranian kingdom established around 323 BC by the Persian satrap Atropates after the death of Alexander the Great. It belonged in turn to the spheres of the Seleucids, Armenia and Rome while keeping its own royal line and Zoroastrian traditions, and its name, through Middle Persian, is the origin of the modern name Azerbaijan.

economy.zh: 经济以高原农业、畜牧与穿越伊朗西北的商路为基础，山地牧场与河谷耕作并存，连接美索不达米亚、亚美尼亚与里海沿岸的贸易带来收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on highland farming, herding and the routes crossing north-western Iran, with mountain pastures and valley cultivation side by side. Trade linking Mesopotamia, Armenia and the Caspian coast brought income to its towns and its ruling house.

culture.zh: 阿特罗帕特尼是琐罗亚斯德教的重要地区，火神庙与祭司传统延续，本地伊朗语与阿拉米文书并用，其宗教与语言传统在伊斯兰时期以前长期保存。
culture.en: Atropatene was an important region of Zoroastrianism, its fire temples and priestly traditions continuing for centuries, and local Iranian speech was used together with Aramaic in documents. Its religious and linguistic traditions survived long before the Islamic period, and later Iranian and Armenian writers still remembered its temples.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元前323年建国、与塞琉古及亚美尼亚的关系、公元前1世纪与罗马的接触，以及此后王统并入更大的伊朗与高加索政治体系。
events.en: Key moments are the founding around 323 BC, its relations with the Seleucids and Armenia, its contacts with Rome in the first century BC and the later absorption of its royal line into the wider Iranian and Caucasian political order.

value.zh: 由波斯总督阿特罗帕特斯建立。
value.en: It was founded by the Persian satrap Atropates.

value.zh: 其名称演变成为今日阿塞拜疆一名的来源。
value.en: Its name evolved into the modern name Azerbaijan.

en: Bagratid Armenia as an independent Armenian state established by Ashot I of the Bagratuni dynasty in the early 880s
Its establishment after nearly two centuries of Umayyad and Abbasid domination of Greater Armenia
Its capital at Ani and its position between the Abbasids and Byzantium
zh: 巴格拉图尼亚美尼亚是巴格拉图尼王朝的阿绍特一世于880年代初建立的独立亚美尼亚国家
建立前大亚美尼亚经历了近两个世纪的倭马亚与阿拔斯统治
以阿尼为都，处在阿拔斯与拜占庭之间

politics.zh: 巴格拉图尼亚美尼亚是巴格拉图尼王朝的阿绍特一世于880年代初建立的独立亚美尼亚国家，此前大亚美尼亚经历了近两个世纪的倭马亚与阿拔斯统治。它处在阿拔斯与拜占庭两大势力之间，以阿尼为都，10世纪在阿绍特三世与加吉克一世时期达到鼎盛；11世纪在拜占庭兼并与塞尔柱入侵下瓦解。
politics.en: Bagratid Armenia was an independent Armenian state established by Ashot I of the Bagratuni dynasty in the early 880s, after nearly two centuries in which Greater Armenia was dominated by the Umayyads and Abbasids. Lying between the two contemporary powers of the region, the Abbasids and Byzantium, it had its capital at Ani and reached its height in the tenth century under Ashot III and Gagik I, breaking up in the eleventh century under Byzantine annexation and Seljuk invasion.

economy.zh: 经济以阿拉斯河谷的农业、手工业与过境贸易为基础，阿尼与德温是商业中心，处在连接拜占庭、波斯与黑海北岸的商路上，税收与手工业行会支撑城市繁荣。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Aras valley, crafts and transit trade, with Ani and Dvin as commercial centres on the routes linking Byzantium, Persia and the northern Black Sea, and taxation and craft guilds supporting urban prosperity.

culture.zh: 巴格拉图尼时期是亚美尼亚建筑与文学的黄金时代，阿尼大教堂与修道院代表其艺术成就，亚美尼亚文字与史学传统延续，阿尼被称为千座教堂之城。
culture.en: The Bagratid period was a golden age of Armenian architecture and literature, the cathedral and monasteries of Ani representing its artistic achievement, the Armenian script and historiographical tradition continuing, and Ani being known as the city of a thousand churches.

events.zh: 关键节点包括880年代阿绍特一世称王、961年迁都阿尼、10世纪末至11世纪初的鼎盛，以及1045年拜占庭兼并阿尼与随后的塞尔柱入侵。
events.en: Key moments are the coronation of Ashot I in the 880s, the transfer of the capital to Ani in 961, the height of the kingdom at the end of the tenth and beginning of the eleventh century, the Byzantine annexation of Ani in 1045 and the Seljuk invasion that followed.

value.en: The capital was moved to Ani in 961.

value.zh: 1045年阿尼被拜占庭兼并，随后遭塞尔柱入侵。
value.en: Ani was annexed by Byzantium in 1045 and the Seljuk invasion followed.

en: The Kingdom of Imereti as a Georgian monarchy established in 1463 by a member of the House of Bagrationi
Its establishment when the Kingdom of Georgia was dissolved into rival kingdoms
Its centre at Kutaisi and its end under Russian rule in 1810
zh: 伊梅雷蒂王国是巴格拉季昂家族成员于1463年建立的格鲁吉亚君主国
在格鲁吉亚王国分裂为多个敌对王国时建立
以库塔伊西为中心，1810年被俄国废除

politics.zh: 伊梅雷蒂王国是巴格拉季昂家族成员于1463年建立的格鲁吉亚君主国，在统一的格鲁吉亚王国分裂为多个敌对王国时产生，以库塔伊西为中心。它在奥斯曼帝国与波斯之间周旋，内部贵族势力强大，王权屡受限制；1810年被俄国废除，其地并入俄国行政体系。
politics.en: The Kingdom of Imereti was a Georgian monarchy established in 1463 by a member of the House of Bagrationi, when the Kingdom of Georgia was dissolved into rival kingdoms, and it was centred on Kutaisi. It manoeuvred between the Ottoman Empire and Persia while powerful nobles repeatedly limited royal authority, and it was abolished by Russia in 1810, its territory being absorbed into the Russian administrative system.

economy.zh: 经济以里奥尼河流域的农业、园艺与手工业为基础，库塔伊西是行政与商业中心，黑海沿岸港口与内陆市场之间的联系带来贸易收入，山地畜牧补充生计。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, horticulture and crafts in the Rioni basin, with Kutaisi as the administrative and commercial centre, trade between the Black Sea ports and inland markets bringing income, and mountain herding adding to local livelihoods.

culture.zh: 伊梅雷蒂保存格鲁吉亚语与东正教传统，教堂与修道院是文化与教育中心，地方王统的编年史与圣像画传统延续，民间音乐与舞蹈传统影响至今。
culture.en: Imereti preserved Georgian language and Orthodox tradition, its churches and monasteries were centres of culture and education, the chronicles and icon painting of its royal court continued, and its folk music and dance traditions remain influential.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1463年王国建立、16至17世纪与奥斯曼及波斯的冲突、18世纪的内部分裂，以及1810年被俄国废除。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the kingdom in 1463, the conflicts with the Ottomans and Persia in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, internal divisions in the eighteenth and its abolition by Russia in 1810.

value.zh: 1463年由巴格拉季昂家族成员建立。
value.en: It was established in 1463 by a member of the House of Bagrationi.

en: The Khanate of Astrakhan as a Tatar rump state of the Golden Horde
Its existence in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries near the mouth of the Volga
Its khans claiming patrilineal descent from Toqa Temur, son of Jochi
zh: 阿斯特拉罕汗国是金帐汗国瓦解后形成的鞑靼残余国家
15至16世纪存在于伏尔加河河口一带
其汗自称出自术赤之子托卡·帖木儿的父系后裔

politics.zh: 阿斯特拉罕汗国是金帐汗国瓦解后形成的鞑靼残余国家，15至16世纪存在于伏尔加河河口一带，即今阿斯特拉罕市附近，其汗自称出自术赤之子托卡·帖木儿的父系后裔。它控制伏尔加河下游与里海北岸的商路，与莫斯科、克里米亚汗国及诺盖人争夺影响力，1556年被俄国伊凡四世吞并。
politics.en: The Khanate of Astrakhan was a Tatar rump state of the Golden Horde that existed in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries near the mouth of the Volga, around the modern city of Astrakhan, and its khans claimed patrilineal descent from Toqa Temur, the thirteenth son of Jochi. It controlled the lower Volga and the trade routes on the northern shore of the Caspian and competed for influence with Moscow, the Crimean Khanate and the Nogais, until Ivan IV of Russia annexed it in 1556.

economy.zh: 经济以伏尔加河下游的畜牧、渔猎与过境贸易为基础，阿斯特拉罕是里海北岸的贸易中心，鱼子酱、盐、皮革与布匹在此集散，商队往返于莫斯科、中亚与波斯之间。
economy.en: The economy rested on herding, fishing and transit trade on the lower Volga, with Astrakhan a commercial centre on the northern Caspian where caviar, salt, hides and cloth were gathered, and caravans travelling between Moscow, Central Asia and Persia.

culture.zh: 汗国居民以鞑靼人为主，伊斯兰教与伏尔加流域的贸易城市文化相结合，清真寺与商队客栈是城市景观，突厥语与波斯语、阿拉伯语用于文书与宗教。
culture.en: The khanate's population was mainly Tatar, and Islam combined with the trading-town culture of the Volga, with mosques and caravanserais shaping its cities. Turkic alongside Persian and Arabic served documents and religion, and its trading quarters were known all along the Volga route.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪中期汗国形成、与莫斯科及克里米亚的争夺、1554年俄国的干预，以及1556年被俄国吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the khanate in the mid-fifteenth century, its contests with Moscow and the Crimea, Russian intervention in 1554 and its annexation by Russia in 1556, after which its khans were taken to Moscow.

value.zh: 位于伏尔加河河口一带。
value.en: It lay near the mouth of the Volga.
